tools.name: discover_assets
tools.description: SouHimBou AI Step 01 — Discover and Classify Assets. Walks the project or system root and automatically inventories: OS (via /etc/os-release), language runtimes (Go, Python, Node.js, Java, Rust), container images (Dockerfile FROM directives), CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform, Ansible), AI agent integrations (Claude, OpenAI, LangChain), MCP server configs, secret stores, and cryptographic libraries. Matches detected assets to applicable STIG profiles (RHEL-09-STIG-V1R3, Container STIG, CNSA 2.0 PQC, AI-Agent-MCP-SEC). Recommends CMMC level (L1/L2/L3) and generates a prioritized list of next tools to run. Output feeds directly into stig_check, cmmc_assess, ert_crypto, ert_architect, and flight_export.

project_path.description: Root path to scan (default: current directory)

tools.name: stig_check
tools.description: SouHimBou AI Step 02 — Run STIG control checks against a project or system. Supports RHEL-09-STIG-V1R3, CIS L1/L2, NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, CMMC, and PQC-Readiness frameworks. Returns CAT I/II/III findings, compliance score, and remediation guidance. 100% offline.

framework.description: STIG framework: RHEL-09-STIG, CIS-L1, CIS-L2, NIST-800-53, NIST-800-171, CMMC, PQC (default: RHEL-09-STIG)

tools.name: cmmc_assess
tools.description: SouHimBou AI Step 02 — CMMC Level 1, 2, or 3 practice assessment. Maps system posture to CMMC 2.0 domains, returns gap analysis with practice-level findings, compliance score, C3PAO readiness flag, and PQC status. 100% offline — no Supabase.

tools.name: agent_record
tools.description: SouHimBou AI Flight Recorder — record an agent action event. In sovereign/air-gap mode (SOUHIMBOU_ENDPOINT not set), writes to the local PQC-signed DAG audit log only. When SOUHIMBOU_ENDPOINT is set, forwards to SouHimBou AI SaaS ingest API. Required fields: action (e.g. tool_called, decision_made, file_modified). Optional: agent_id, tool_name, session_id, metadata.

action.description: Action type: tool_called, decision_made, file_modified, etc.

tools.name: flight_export

Reads the tamper-evident NDJSON flight log, verifies the ML-DSA-65 signed chain, and returns an EvidencePacket with SOW pilot KPIs: tool_calls_captured, signed_privileged_pct, mean_evidence_time_ms, control_mapping_count. Ready for C3PAO submission.

Scores each risk 0-100, lists active KHEPRA controls and gaps, generates a PQC-signed evidence packet with executive summary and production readiness verdict. 100% offline. The only MCP tool that maps your agent stack to OWASP Agentic Top 10 with ML-DSA-65 signed evidence.

profile.description: Assessment profile: full | quick | executive (default: full)

tools.name: dark_crypto_contribute
tools.description: Dark Crypto Intelligence Network - Community Tier contribution tool. Accepts crypto findings from discover_assets or ert_crypto, strips ALL sensitive data (no file paths, IPs, hostnames, credentials collected), and submits anonymized cryptographic algorithm inventory to the Nouchix Dark Crypto Intelligence Network. Returns: global quantum exposure rank, quantum risk level, community statistics, and remediation recommendations. Offline mode: queues to ~/.khepra/dark_crypto_queue/ when unreachable. COMMUNITY TIER: no license key required. GDPR compliant, NIST SP 800-188 de-identification compliant.

findings.description: Array of crypto finding objects from discover_assets or ert_crypto. Each object: algorithm (required), library_name, library_version, usage_pattern, quantum_vulnerable.

algorithms.description: Simple mode: comma-separated algorithm names e.g. RSA-2048,AES-128-CBC,SHA-1

tools.name: pqc_stig
tools.description: World's First DoD PQC Security Technical Implementation Guide (PQC-01-STIG-V1R1). Runs 12 PQC-specific STIG controls exclusively — FIPS 203 (ML-KEM/Kyber), FIPS 204 (ML-DSA/Dilithium), FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA/SPHINCS+). Aligned to NSA CNSA 2.0. DISA has no PQC STIG as of mid-2026; this fills that gap for DoD contractors, C3PAOs, and FedRAMP system owners. CAT I: algorithm approval + key strength (ML-DSA-65 / ML-KEM-768 minimums). CAT II: hybrid crypto, key protection, constant-time implementation, PQC certificates. CAT III: audit logging, key rotation documentation, full-stack PQC coverage. Returns structured compliance score, CNSA 2.0 control mapping, migration timeline, and immediate remediation actions. Profiles: full (all 12 controls), quick (CAT I failures only), executive (summary stats). PHARAOH TIER: requires Enterprise license key.

scan_path.description: Path to the source code directory to assess (default: current directory). Relative to the project root. Examples: '.', 'pkg/', 'src/crypto/'. NOT an OS target — use stig_check for OS STIG assessments.

profile.description: Assessment profile: full (all 12 controls, default) | quick (CAT I failures only) | executive (summary stats, no per-finding detail).
